en.title: Gears Beneath the Still Waters
en.premise: Kai, a young man who researches "lost technology" recovered from the ruins of a sunken civilization, meets Lina, a girl who has lost her voice to illness. As they work together to repair fragments of a steam engine hidden within the relics, they begin to confront memories long forgotten. The ruins, which emerge only when the tide recedes, serve as a bridge for conversing with the dead. In the depths of despair, they search for a flicker of light.

zh.title: 凪之底的齿轮
zh.premise: 青年凯致力于研究从沉没文明的海底遗迹中回收的“失落技术”，并在此过程中遇见了因病失去声音的少女莉娜。两人在修复遗物中沉睡的蒸汽机碎片时，逐渐面对起失落的记忆。仅在退潮时才会现身的遗迹，亦是与死者对话之所。在绝望的深渊中，他们将寻找那一抹微光。
